text:
Sara: Quick heads-up — I opened a PR that updates the Python SDK example in the migration guide and fixes one URI that 404s. Need 1 tech review + tone/terminology pass. Hoping to merge today around 16:00 PT if CI is green. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/428
Kevin: @Sara I can take the tech glance. Will check snippet correctness and imports. 
Alex: I can do the voice/terminology pass after Kevin. Quick Q — do we prefer `Redwood API` or `Redwood inference API` in the guide? We should pick one and use it consistently.
Sara: good call. Our style doc prefers "Redwood API" for product references and "Redwood Inference" only in org context. I'll update the PR description to note that.
Kevin: looked at the snippet — small nit: import path is `from redwood import Client` but our Python package is `redwood_inference`. Change to `from redwood_inference import Client`. Also `client.generate(...)` example needs explicit `model="gpt-3x"` param for clarity.
Sara: thanks — I'll push that fix now.
Jamal: heads-up from CI — docs-netbot shows the preview build failed on a linkcheck step, 1 broken link in the migration guide (the URI Sara mentioned). Once that's fixed CI will re-run.
docs-bot: Preview build queued: https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.internal/preview/428 — currently failing linkcheck.
Sara: pushed a tiny commit to fix the import and link. Also added a one-line note about error handling in the snippet.
Kevin: re-reviewed, snippet code looks correct. Left one inline about formatting: prefer triple-backtick fenced blocks with language `python` and no trailing whitespace.
Alex: quick tone review: sample language is good, but swap "we" to "Redwood" in the sentence "we recommend pinning model versions" — org voice prefers third person. Also change `endpoint` to `route` in this doc (our glossary flags endpoint for infra docs).
Sara: done both, pushed. Also added a short rationale comment in PR describing the `route` change per glossary.
Jamal: preview finished — all checks passed. docs-bot: Preview: https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.internal/preview/428 (green)
docs-bot: CI status: ✅ all checks passed (linkcheck, lint, unit examples)
Kevin: LGTM from me — tech ok.
Alex: tone LGTM. One tiny phrasing nit but not blocking: change "pin model versions" -> "pin model revisions" in the migration notes. Not required for today if we're short on time, but good to follow up.
Sara: thanks both — can anyone take the merge slot at 16:00 PT? I won't be at my keyboard exactly then to hit merge.
Kevin: I can merge at 16:00 PT. Will squash and use the PR description.
Alex: thanks Kevin — please add `chore(docs):` prefix in the merge commit message per our changelog convention.
Kevin: will do. Merging at 16:00 PT. :rocket:
Sara: appreciate it! I'll follow up on Alex's suggested phrasing in a follow-up PR if needed.
